note.es: Base derivada: suma propia de cifras con condiciones de uso distintas, incluidas CC BY-SA y ODbL; cada cifra conserva las de su fuente (campo license de cada componente). Depende de la ONU para los países listados en international_fallback: sin ellos no habría total de los 20.
note.en: Derived database: our own sum of figures under different terms of use, including CC BY-SA and ODbL; each figure keeps those of its source (license field of each component). It relies on the UN for the countries listed in international_fallback: without them there would be no total of the 20.
